shared_elements: row of repeated human figures in profile
procession/line arrangement along a horizontal register
schematic stick-like human bodies (in B, crew figures)
justification: Both surfaces show a horizontal line of repeated human figures facing the same direction, but in A these are naturalistically modelled robed men with garments, headdresses and carried vessels approaching a larger seated/standing dignitary, while in B they are minimal stick strokes standing as crew on a boat hull. The dominant motif of B, the ship with upturned prow and stern, has no counterpart in A, and A's rosette border and offering-bearing gestures have none in B; the rendering conventions (rounded volumetric relief vs flat linear silhouette) are wholly different.
